jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - IT Recruitment Consultant (Sales & Recruitment)
jobs.description:
Or you have a strong Sales mindset and looking for your first job?

At Oliver James, we're looking for ambitious 360° Recruitment Consultants to grow our Belgian IT market.

This is not a traditional HR role. You will build your own market, develop new business, headhunt top IT talent and manage the recruitment process from A to Z.
The role

• Build and develop your own Belgian market

• Prospect and win new clients to build your portfolio

• Develop long-term relationships with decision-makers

• Head-hunt, interview and advise IT professionals

• Manage the recruitment process from A to Z

• Negotiate with clients and candidates

• Own your targets, pipeline and results

• Become an expert in your market

Who are we looking for?

Experienced Recruiters who want more commercial ownership, earning potential and career progression.

Sales Professionals with a strong background in B2B Sales, business development or account management who want to build a career in recruitment.

In both cases, you are:

• Ambitious, competitive and commercially driven

• Comfortable with targets and prospecting

• A strong communicator and negotiator

• Fluent in French OR Dutch + English

• Holding a Bachelor's or Master's degree

 

We care more about your ability to build relationships, win business and deliver results than your job title.
-

CLdN is a leading provider of integrated quay-to-quay and door-to-door logistics solutions. Founded in 1929, CLdN ensures reliable, cost-effective transport that links the major economic areas of Europe. With 30 ships and more than 200 sailings a week, CLdN provides shortsea connections between the European continent, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Iberia and Scandinavia and offers the lowest CO2 footprint of all Western European RoRo operators. CLdN’s cargo and multimodal services have a Europe-wide reach using CLdN’s extensive network of ships, terminals and equipment. CLdN’s 3,000 employees ensure that it fulfills its mission: to excel as an integrated provider of maritime links.  
 

Are you looking for the next step in your payroll career?
 

Are you an experienced payroll professional who enjoys working in an international environment, thrives on accuracy and compliance, and likes to take ownership? Then this role may be the perfect next step in your career.
 

Your role
 
 

• As Senior Payroll Officer, you support the Payroll Lead in ensuring accurate, timely and compliant payroll operations across the continent countries where CLdN operates. 

• You play a key role in the execution, control and continuous improvement of payroll processes. Working closely with the Payroll Lead, you independently manage end-to-end payroll activities for assigned countries and can take ownership of international payroll operations when required. 

Your profile
 
 

•   Minimum 5 years of payroll experience, preferably in an international or multi-country environment.  

• Solid understanding of payroll operations, tax legislation, social security regulations and labour law requirements.  

• Proven ability to independently manage payroll processes and complex payroll cases.  

• Experience working with external payroll providers and HRIS/payroll systems.  

• Strong analytical skills and a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.  

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and stakeholders across different countries.  

• Proactive, reliable and solution-oriented mindset.  

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.  

• Fluent in English; additional languages are considered an asset.

Responsibilities

• Develop software components using .NET Framework and .NET Core.
• Design scalable and maintainable solutions in collaboration with the architecture team.
• Provide technical coaching and mentorship to team members.
• Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to development best practices.
• Analyze functional requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
• Optimize system performance while ensuring security and maintainability.
• Evaluate and integrate new technologies that align with organizational objectives.

Requirements

• 8+ years of backend development experience using C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework.
• 3+ years of experience with ASP.NET Web API, MVC, and REST APIs including Swagger/OpenAPI.
• 3+ years of experience with Entity Framework Core and SQL Server.
• You possess experience with Authentication/Authorization protocols such as JWT, OIDC, and claims-based identity.
• You have a strong background in Unit Testing and Integration Testing.
• You bring a structured, solution-oriented mindset and the ability to lead technically.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French with a very good level of English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Blazor.
• Proactive approach to evaluating emerging technologies.

Are you an experienced HR professional looking for a role where you can combine hands-on HR management with strategic organisational development?

Our client is a growing international organisation based in Brussels, with teams across several European countries. As the organisation continues to expand, they are looking for an HR Manager to build and structure their HR function and support their international growth.

This is a broad role with significant autonomy, working closely with leadership and managers across multiple countries.

Your responsibilities as HR Manager

As HR Manager, you will be responsible for developing a lean, scalable and effective HR framework while ensuring excellent day-to-day HR support.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing and structuring recruitment processes in line with the organisation's growth plans.
• Overseeing onboarding, offboarding and employee lifecycle processes.
• Ensuring HR policies and practices are compliant across different European jurisdictions.
• Working with external payroll providers and HR partners.
• Developing and implementing HR policies and processes.
• Supporting managers with performance management, employee development and coaching.
• Developing training and learning initiatives.
• Contributing to workforce planning and organisational development.
• Providing HR insights and data to support strategic decision-making.
• Supporting leadership on employee engagement, wellbeing and company culture.
• Advising managers on HR-related matters and contributing to the development of a strong performance culture.

Your profile as HR Manager

• You have several years of experience in a broad HR management role, ideally within an international environment.
• You have strong experience in recruitment, ideally across different countries.
• You possess a solid understanding of Belgian employment law and HR compliance, particularly in an international context.
• You have experience with performance management, coaching and employee development.
• You are comfortable building and structuring HR processes in a growing organisation.
• You are both strategic and hands-on, happy to move between long-term projects and operational HR matters.
• You are an excellent communicator and confident stakeholder manager.
• You are fluent in English and French ; additional European languages are an asset.
• You are comfortable working in an environment where priorities evolve quickly and where you can genuinely shape the HR function.

Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain XR simulator systems and mechanics using Unity and C#.
• Write clean, maintainable code while implementing debugging and optimization techniques for simulator performance.
• Collaborate with 3D artists, designers, and operational end-users to ensure simulation authenticity.
• Implement core XR training features and interactive scenarios that reflect real-world situations.
• Ensure smooth performance across various XR platforms through identification and resolution of bottlenecks.
• Create rapid prototypes and iterate on features to meet specific training requirements.

Requirements

• You have 1+ years experience in game development using Unity and C#.
• You bring experience in developing XR simulators (VR, AR, MR) specifically for training or simulation environments.
• You possess a comprehensive portfolio demonstrating past technical development work.
• You have a strong grasp of physics, mathematics, and algorithms as applied to simulator development.
• You have knowledge of game design principles and interactive training mechanics.
• You're a proactive problem-solver with strong communication skills for working in multidisciplinary teams.
• You have active knowledge of Dutch, French, and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with 3D scanning, LIDAR, or photogrammetry and digital reconstruction.
• Prior experience in operational training environments or security services.

jobs.occupation: IT System Engineer – International Industrial Environment
jobs.description:
As an IT System Engineer, you are responsible for the reliability, security and continuous evolution of the IT infrastructure.
 You work proactively and structurally, focusing on improvement and prevention rather than firefighting. 

Your responsibilities include:
  
• Managing and optimizing the Windows Server environment 
• Patch management and vulnerability management (e.g. Tanium, Qualys) 
• Active involvement in IT security and compliance 
• 2nd and 3rd line support for end users 
• Incident analysis through root cause analysis and implementation of structural solutions 
• Participation in IT projects (infrastructure, security, international roll-outs)  
This role is not about “putting out fires”, but about building, standardizing and professionalizing the IT landscape.
 
Team & collaboration
 
You will be part of a small IT team (±3 people), which means:
  
• short communication lines, 
• direct visibility of your impact, 
• a high level of autonomy and trust.  
You will also collaborate with internal stakeholders and international colleagues across Europe.

Must-have 
 
• 4–5 years of experience in IT infrastructure or system engineering 
• Strong knowledge of Windows Server 
• Experience with patching and vulnerability management 
• Analytical mindset with a focus on root cause analysis 
• Structured, process-oriented way of working, including documentation 
• Hands-on mindset combining support and infrastructure  
Languages
  
• Dutch or French as main working language 
• Good command of the second national language 
• English is required for international collaboration  
Nice-to-have
  
• Knowledge of firewalls and networking concepts 
• Experience with Azure / Entra ID / cloud environments 
• Knowledge of Power BI or SQL 
• Experience with Intune or CRM environments 
• Background in an industrial or production environment 
• Experience in international projects

This is a highly visible role offering a balanced mix of operational service management, stakeholder engagement, governance, and project delivery. Rather than being a hands-on technical expert, you will ensure that IT services are delivered efficiently, compliantly, and in line with both local business needs and international standards.

• Manage external suppliers, including service levels, contracts, costs, quality, and performance.
• Facilitate collaboration between business stakeholders, international IT teams, and service providers to deliver sustainable and effective solutions.
• Ensure accurate documentation and compliance with group IT governance and control frameworks.

IT Infrastructure, Network & Digital Workplace

• Coordinate infrastructure and digital workplace services in partnership with international IT teams and external vendors.

• Oversee incident management processes and ensure timely escalation to the appropriate teams.
• Support the alignment of global IT standards and processes with local operational requirements.
• Represent the local organization within international IT communities and initiatives.

Project Management & Product Ownership

• Coordinate and follow up on IT projects involving internal stakeholders and external partners.
• Translate business requirements into practical IT solutions, acting as the bridge between local business needs and the central IT roadmap.
• Ensure successful implementation and delivery of technology solutions within agreed timelines and scope.
• Manage project scope, planning, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with international colleagues and key stakeholders.

• Monitor IT-related expenditures, invoices, and budgets.

jobs.occupation: Accounting and Reporting Manager in Brussels
jobs.description:
This newly created position combines technical accounting expertise, business partnering and people management, offering the opportunity to build and develop a function with significant visibility across the organization.

You will work closely with a variety of stakeholders while ensuring accurate reporting, financial transparency and high-quality service delivery.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will oversee accounting and reporting activities for centrally managed costs and third-party managed assets while acting as a trusted finance partner to key stakeholders.

• Partner with central functions such as IT, Legal and other support teams on financial performance and cost management.
• Own the accounting, reporting and control of centrally managed expenditures.
• Manage the reporting and relationship with third-party property owners, ensuring accurate information and timely responses to inquiries.
• Review monthly financial results, analyse variances and provide clear financial insights.
• Coordinate month-end closing activities, reconciliations and intercompany recharges.
• Drive process improvements, strengthen controls and support systems-related initiatives.
• Lead, coach and develop a small team, fostering collaboration and high performance.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent experience.
• Solid accounting background with at least 7 years of experience in accounting and financial reporting.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication skills - French and Dutch
• Previous experience managing and developing team members, with a genuine interest in people leadership.
• Strong business partnering mindset and the ability to build effective relationships with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
• Experience working in an international, multi-entity or shared services environment is a plus.
• Strong knowledge of SAP; experience with ERP implementations or system improvements is highly valued.

Leading a team of three, you will ensure the smooth running of the procure-to-pay cycle, support internal stakeholders and drive continuous improvements that contribute to stronger controls and faster supplier payments.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will manage the purchase order administration function and ensure the quality, accuracy and efficiency of related financial processes.

• Lead and support a team of three responsible for purchase order administration activities.
• Ensure purchase orders are created accurately and processed in line with internal procedures.
• Oversee supplier master data management, ensuring vendor information and bank details remain accurate and compliant.
• Maintain product catalogues and ensure pricing, descriptions and accounting information are up to date.
• Act as a key support partner for internal stakeholders, providing guidance on purchase order and supplier administration processes.
• Ensure compliance with approval workflows, financial controls and procure-to-pay procedures.
• Drive process improvements that enhance efficiency and support faster supplier payments.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent experience.
• Proven experience in Accounts Payable, Accounting, Finance Operations or a similar environment.
• Fluent in English and either Dutch or French.
• Experience leading a team, or the ambition to take the next step from Team Lead to Manager.
• Strong understanding of procure-to-pay processes, purchase orders and supplier data management.
• Hands-on SAP experience is essential.
• A structured and detail-oriented professional with a strong focus on accuracy, controls and process efficiency.
